name: write_tool_files
description: Write the files of a tool-under-construction to its directory on disk. Used by the tool_builder agent loop. Pass the snake_case `tool_name` and a `files` list, where each item is an object with `name` (the flat filename) and `content` (the full file text), e.g. [{"name": "tool.py", "content": "..."}, {"name": "requirements.txt", "content": "..."}, {"name": "tool.json", "content": "..."}]. Files are written to data/tenants/<tenant>/user_tools/<tool_name>/ and chowned so the runtime can build a venv inside. Overwrites existing files. Returns a one-line summary of what was written.

tool_name.description: Snake_case tool name. Lowercase, digits, underscores; starts with a letter.

files.description: List of files to write. Each item is an object with `name` (flat filename, e.g. tool.py) and `content` (full file text). Typically tool.py, requirements.txt, tool.json. No subdirectories.

name.description: Flat filename, e.g. tool.py or requirements.txt.

content.description: Full text content of the file.
